subject: Who may publish, who may chat, and how a site selects its Organization
note: Two different credentials publish and chat. The site publisher is Node-only and uses an org machine token; browser chat uses a publishable origin-bound website API key, which authenticates its origin and never an Organization membership. Treating one as the other is the failure this contract exists to prevent: a publishable key can never publish, and an org machine token must never reach a browser, a static file, a PUBLIC_* variable or a chat embed.

publish_token.transport: Node only (CLI or build tooling); never browser code, a static file, a PUBLIC_* variable or a chat embed
publish_token.scope: site publish (admin-scoped org machine credential today; a narrower site_publish-only credential is the product follow-up)
publish_token.redaction: the publisher redacts any crk_ value from output

publishable_website_key.used_by: browser chat and embedded chat, against the organization's public surfaces

capability_tiers.site_publish: site publish scope only; not a capability-battery principal

handle_resolution.rule: the resolved handle selects the target Organization; it is not an authorization credential
handle_resolution.missing: an unresolved handle is a usage error, never a fallback to another Organization
